_comment: Graph model of Donat's technical knowledge. Agents: read at session start, use concept levels to calibrate explanations, traverse edges to find explanation anchors, update when Donat signals.

background_job.label: background job (async task outside HTTP request)

sha.label: commit SHA (hash that identifies a commit)

crlf.label: CRLF (Windows line endings vs Unix LF)

solid_queue.label: solid_queue (DB-backed job queue for Rails 8)
solid_queue.note: 2026-05-31: knows background_job concept; solid_queue internals unknown

agent_rules.level_0: Full explanation required. Follow edges to find the nearest level-2/3 neighbor and anchor the explanation there. Example: solid_queue (level 0) -> background_job (level 2, known): 'solid_queue olyan mint egy background job rendszer (amit ismersz), csak Rails 8-ban PostgreSQL-ben tárolja a sorba állt feladatokat Redis helyett.'
agent_rules.level_1: Brief parenthetical on first use per session. One clause, not a sentence.
agent_rules.level_2: Skip basics. Explain depth, internals, and edge cases only when directly relevant.
agent_rules.wants_to_learn_true: At level 2-3, proactively offer to deepen when a natural moment arises. Don't force it every message.
agent_rules.unknown_concept: If not in concepts dict, treat as level 0 and add after the session.

update_protocol.mi_az_X: Set level to 0 (or 1 if partial understanding likely); add note: 'YYYY-MM-DD: asked what X is — [one-line context]'; Edit file.
update_protocol.nem_ertem: level = 0; add note: 'YYYY-MM-DD: did not understand after explanation — [context]'; Edit file.
update_protocol.new_concept_encountered: Add to concepts with level 0 (or calibrated from context). Add edge if connected to existing concept. Edit file.
